core.title: Forged Steel Shutter Dogs, Acorn AKCBQ

text.description_html:
Acorn AKCBQ, Hand Forged Steel Shutter Dogs

Shutter dogs are designed to fasten shutters open. Available for both wood and brick mounting, the hand forged steel shutter dogs are packaged with aluminum anti-rattle hooks, stainless steel fasteners, and anchors for brick application. The matte black finish is perfect finishing touch for traditional homes; and the swirling, tendril design is a lovely reminder of the natural world.

Specifications and Features of the Forged Steel Shutter Dogs:

  • Material: Steel.
  • Finish: Black
  • Length: 5-3/4"
  • Width: 1-3/8"
  • Stainless Steel Lag Screw: 4" x 3/8"
  • Comes packaged with 2 shutter dogs, 2 lag screws, and 2 aluminum anti-rattle hooks. Anchors are supplied for Brick Application Shutter Dogs.

Priced and sold in pairs (2 shutter dogs).
